title: boardui component model mapping
description: Maps parts or packages to user-supplied glTF/GLB body models (boardui convert --models). Model conventions: Y-up, metres, origin at the package origin, top-side placement at 0° rotation, seating plane at y = 0. Matching tries part rules first, then package rules; the first match wins. See spec/README.md §6.9.

file.description: Path to a .glb or .gltf file, relative to the mapping file.

offsetMm.description: Translation applied in the model's frame, in millimetres.

rotationDeg.description: XYZ Euler rotation applied in the model's frame before placement, in degrees.

scale.description: Uniform scale, e.g. 0.001 for a model authored in millimetres.
